scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.dev: concurrently --names web,api,workflow --prefix-colors cyan,green,yellow "pnpm dev:web" "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:workflow"
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis temporal temporal-ui
scripts.lint: biome check . && cd apps/workflow && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.test: pnpm -r --if-present test && cd apps/workflow && uv run pytest
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && cd apps/workflow && uv run mypy src
